• The word **"Curiousity"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Curiosity"**.
 
• **​"Curiosity"** means a strong desire to know or learn something. (जिज्ञासा)
 
 
• **Example: **His **curiosity **about space drove him to study astronomy.

• **Vehemence** (उग्रता): The display of strong feeling or passion.

• **Superficial** (ऊपरी): Existing or occurring at or on the surface.
 
 
• **Example: **His understanding of the topic was **superficial **and lacked depth.
